header.goal: Your goal: be able to understand and describe locations, positions, and related details.

words.sp: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī xiǎomāo.
words.se: My family has a small cat.

words.sp: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū.
words.se: There is a book on the table.
He loved reading all his life.
I plan to go to the bookstore.

grammar.title: 2. Noun + 下 / 上 / 里 / 外 / 前 / 后 / 外边 = location words (under, on, in, outside, in front, behind, outside).
grammar.py: Chuáng xià yǒu yì zhī māo.
grammar.en: There’s a cat under the bed.

tips: Shadow it: play a word, pause, and repeat it right away. Copy the pitch, not just the sounds.
Mind the tones: 水 (shuǐ) dips down then up, and 茶 (chá) rises like a question.
Go slow, then fast: say each sentence slowly three times, then at normal speed.
Hide the Pinyin: try the cards with Pinyin off and see how many you recognize.
